query:
SELECT state_code, district, status, candidate1_name, candidate1_party, candidate2_name, candidate2_party 
FROM house_races WHERE state_code = 'WV' ORDER BY district;

-- WV-1: Carol Miller (R, 72%) won, V. George (D, 53%) won
-- WV-2: R. Moore (R, unopposed), A. Parsi (D, 39.8% plurality) won
